jobs.title: Director, Data Science
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Director, Data Science

Overview

The Security Solutions Data Science team is responsible for delivering Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) models that support Mastercard’s Identity and risk products across the payment networks. These models are designed to be production-ready and to power high-value capabilities that protect digital transactions and enable trusted decisioning at scale.

Beyond model development, the organization is responsible for building scalable, repeatable, and resilient data science capabilities that cover the end-to-end lifecycle of machine learning solutions, from data acquisition and feature engineering through experimentation, validation, deployment, and monitoring. These systems must not only perform effectively in production, but also be built in a way that is industrialized, maintainable, and aligned with broader business and platform needs.

Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. Within this mission, the Identity Data Science portfolio plays a significant role in developing intelligence-driven solutions that improve how risk is understood and managed across the merchant lifecycle.

We are looking for a highly skilled and strategic Director to lead a Data Science team that focuses on solving merchant risk during onboarding and monitoring. This role is critical in driving the research and development of a merchant registry and profiling capability within the Identity Data Science portfolio. This includes setting the strategy for how merchant intelligence is built and scaled, guiding the development of reusable data science assets and profiling frameworks, and ensuring strong execution across product, engineering, and data science partners. You will help shape both the technical direction and operational model needed to turn this capability into a durable and scalable advantage.

Role

Key Responsibilities Include

Define and execute the strategy for solving merchant risk during onboarding and monitoring through the research and development of a merchant registry and profiling capability
Lead, coach, and develop high-performing teams of Data Scientists, including hiring, mentorship, and performance management
Build a strong team culture focused on collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning
Guide the design of scalable machine learning and analytical systems using modern data and cloud platforms such as Databricks and Sparks.
Establish best practices for problem framing, technique selection, experimentation, and validation across the team
Ensure teams identify appropriate approaches for business problems and rigorously validate solutions against both technical and business outcomes
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders to translate strategic needs into data science roadmaps and deliverables
Drive Agile delivery practices that support iterative development, measurable outcomes, and continuous improvement
Promote reusable data assets, standardization, and scalable workflows that strengthen long-term execution
Communicate strategy, progress, trade-offs, and business value clearly to senior leadership
Balance long-term vision with near-term delivery to maximize impact and time-to-value

All About You

Essential Skills to be successful:

Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD preferred) in Data Science, ML, or related field
Extensive experience leading a Data Science team and drive innovation with inspiration.
Experienced being a great people leader but able to dig into the work where necessary
A proven track record of deploying high performance machine learning models at scale in a production environment
Strong proficiency with Python, SQL, along with experience using scalable Machine Learning and Cloud frameworks
Strong ability to guide teams in identifying appropriate techniques and validating solutions rigorously
Critical thinking and a drive to produce high-quality work, ensuring that all solutions meet rigorous standards
Demonstrated success translating complex business problems into strategic data science initiatives. Ability to lead through ambiguity and change
Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, with the ability to drive iterative delivery across cross-functional teams
Excellent stakeholder management, communication to both technical and non-technical audiences, and leadership skills
Proven ability to build teams, influence roadmaps, and deliver measurable business value in complex environments
High-energy and self-driven orientation

Nice to Have

Experience building or scaling shared data science platforms, registries, or enterprise data assets
Familiarity with merchant risk, fraud, or identity ecosystems
Experience driving cross-team standardization and reusable capabilities
Exposure to governance frameworks for model validation and AI systems

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in Canada, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive pay based on location, experience and other qualifications for the role and may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. This is a pipeline posting for future opportunities within our team.

Pay Ranges

Vancouver, Canada: $154,000 - $247,000 CAD

Toronto, Canada: $154,000 - $247,000 CAD

jobs.title: Finance & Human Resources Leader
jobs.description:
Location: Kingsville, Ontario
Vacancy: This posting is for a currently open position.
Salary Range: $130,000 – $150,000 base salary

COMPANY PROFILE

Our client is a fast-growing Canadian manufacturer of custom conveyor systems, material handling solutions, and precision metal products that has doubled their business in the past 2 years. They credit this success in large part to talented professionals who make up their world-class manufacturing team. They are committed to sustaining this period of growth, investing in the people, equipment, process improvements, and technology the business needs to scale effectively.

As the company enters its next phase of growth, it is establishing a new Finance & Human Resources Leader position. The Finance function has been overseen by the President & CEO and is now being transitioned to a dedicated leader who will assume full ownership of Finance, join the senior leadership team, and build on a strong existing foundation. With a capable team already managing the day-to-day finance and administrative activities, the focus will be on providing strategic leadership, strengthening the function, and supporting the company’s continued growth.

JOB SUMMARY

Reporting to the General Manager, the Finance & Human Resources Leader will lead the Finance function while providing oversight of Human Resources. This is a key leadership role responsible for financial reporting, planning, controls, and performance analysis, with a strong focus on manufacturing operations. The successful candidate will bring financial insight to business decisions, strengthen processes and reporting, and serve as a trusted partner to the General Manager and leadership team. The role also provides HR direction and oversight, supported by internal resources and external partners as needed- the individual does not need to be an HR specialist.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Finance & Financial Leadership

Lead the Finance function, overseeing financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, cash flow, working capital, and overall financial performance.
Prepare and communicate financial statements, management reporting, and analysis, providing actionable insights to the President & CEO and leadership team.
Oversee core financial operations, including AR, AP, payroll, banking, tax, audit, insurance and compliance, while maintaining strong financial controls and processes.
Provide financial oversight for capital expenditures and key business decisions, assessing risks, opportunities, and financial impact.

Manufacturing Finance

Develop a strong understanding of the company’s engineer-to-order manufacturing model and its key financial drivers.
Provide visibility into job costing, WIP, project margins and profitability, analyzing estimated versus actual performance across labour, materials and overhead.
Establish meaningful financial and operational KPIs and partner with Estimating, Sales, Engineering and Operations to translate operational performance into actionable financial insights.
Identify opportunities to improve margins, profitability, efficiency and working-capital management.

Human Resources

Provide leadership and oversight of the Human Resources function, ensuring policies and practices support business objectives, company culture and employment legislation.
Partner with managers on employee relations, performance management, recruitment, onboarding, retention, succession planning, compensation and benefits.

Leadership & Continuous Improvement

Serve as a trusted business partner to the President & CEO and an active member of the leadership team, contributing to strategic and organizational priorities.
Strengthen financial and HR systems, processes and reporting while identifying opportunities to automate repetitive work and leverage technology and AI to improve efficiency and decision-making.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Minimum 7 years of progressively senior experience in finance and accounting, ideally within a manufacturing environment; CPA designation is an asset.
Background in custom manufacturing, engineer-to-order, project-based, or similarly complex production settings.
Strong understanding of cost accounting, WIP, gross margin analysis, project profitability, and budget-to-actual performance.
Proven experience managing financial planning, forecasting, reporting, P&L oversight and cash flow management.
Strong knowledge of accounting practices, financial controls and governance, with experience improving financial processes and infrastructure.
Previous exposure to HR leadership or functional oversight, with an understanding of employee practices, policies and employment compliance.
Business-oriented and analytical, with the ability to connect financial and operational data to sound, practical business decisions.
Confident communicator and approachable leader who can build strong relationships across the organization, from senior leadership to front-line employees.
Proactive, hands-on, and continuous improvement-focused, with an openness to using technology, automation, and AI to enhance business efficiency.

If you’re a hands-on finance leader looking to shape both the financial and people side of a growing manufacturing business, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact. Please send your resume to lead executive search consultant Charles Warren
by selecting the “Apply” option and following the required steps.

Thank you in advance for your interest, only individuals deemed to have the skill set and experience to fit the role will be contacted. Applicants must be legally entitled to work in Canada without sponsorship.

Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

This is a hybrid position with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

This position can be based in Montreal, Toronto or Ottawa.

Your Role

In an environment where data has become a critical strategic asset supporting decision-making, advanced analytics and artificial intelligence solutions, CBC/Radio-Canada is implementing an enterprise-wide data governance program. The creation of the Director, Enterprise Data Governance role is at the heart of this transformation and aims to establish the foundations required for the effective, secure and consistent management of information assets.

Key Responsibilities

Framework, Policies & Compliance

Develop, refine, and enforce enterprise-wide data governance policies, directives, and standards aligned with corporate priorities.
Work with Legal, InfoSec, and Data Engineering to establish data classification rules, access controls, and compliance monitoring.
Define core data concepts and maintain central governance documentation and artifacts.

Core Programs & Data Operations

Data Catalog & Metadata: Oversee the implementation of an enterprise data catalog and metadata management processes to ensure reporting mechanisms and datasets are clear and accessible.
Data Quality & Lineage: Stand up an enterprise data quality program and implement data lineage tracking to monitor how data moves across systems.
Usability & AI Readiness: Partner with technology and analytics teams to make sure data is clean and structured for BI, reporting, and AI/ML models.

Governance Bodies & Stakeholder Leadership

Manage the Enterprise Data Governance Steering Committee to align senior leadership on strategic priorities.
Lead the Enterprise Data Council (domain leads and Data Officers) to translate strategic directives into policies and actionable initiatives.
Drive the creation of cross-functional networks of data stewards, owners, custodians, and working groups as needed.

Data Literacy & Culture

Lead change management, training, and communication programs to improve overall data literacy across the corporation.
Influence senior executives and business stakeholders to adopt governance practices and understand their role in protecting and using data.
Build, mentor, and lead a small, high-impact data governance team.

Metrics, KPI Tracking & Reporting

Define, track, and report on core governance KPIs, including data quality, issue resolution, policy compliance, and user adoption.
Build and maintain executive dashboards to regularly report program progress and outcomes to leadership.

What You Bring

Qualifications, experience & skills

5+ years of experience in data management, governance, or a related field.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
Proven experience building and launching enterprise data governance programs.
Experience leading enterprise-grade data catalog / data governance tooling initiatives.
Experience developing and managing a business glossary.
Experience operating in a national, matrixed organization.
Bilingualism (English and French).

Technical

Core Skills & Technical Proficiencies: Strong hands-on experience with SQL, data modeling, structured/unstructured data governance, and ETL/ELT logic. Profiency withPython, Jira, and workflow mapping tools is a key asset.
Governance Tooling & Platforms: Hands-on experience with integrating and/or heavy use of enterprise data governance tools (e.g., Collibra, Alation, Informatica, Purview) and familiarity with major cloud-based data platforms (e.g.: Google Cloud Platform, Azure).
Data Lifecycle & Quality Operations: Proven track record in building and validating data lineage, managing data quality validation/remediation, and creating or overseeing automated scripts for metadata harvesting and validation.
Architecture & Team Collaboration: Deep understanding of modern data architectures (cloud data platforms, BI/analytics, AI/ML pipelines) paired with a strong ability to collaborate across technical, product, vendor, and business teams.
Communication & Technical Translation: Exceptional ability to translate complex technical, architectural, and regulatory concepts into clear, actionable business language.
Nice-to-Have Technical Assets: Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and API-based metadata harvesting.

Non-technical

Ability to understand and communicate the value of data as an asset.
Ability to manage cross-functional teams.
Business and technical requirements documentation skills.
Strong project management and organizational skills.
Excellent communication and facilitation abilities.
Ability to lead by influence and work across teams and business units at varying levels of data governance maturity.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.

A mandatory Criminal record check.

new_jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Director, Data Science

Overview

The Security Solutions Data Science team is responsible for delivering Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) models that support Mastercard’s Identity and risk products across the payment networks. These models are designed to be production-ready and to power high-value capabilities that protect digital transactions and enable trusted decisioning at scale.

Beyond model development, the organization is responsible for building scalable, repeatable, and resilient data science capabilities that cover the end-to-end lifecycle of machine learning solutions, from data acquisition and feature engineering through experimentation, validation, deployment, and monitoring. These systems must not only perform effectively in production, but also be built in a way that is industrialized, maintainable, and aligned with broader business and platform needs.

Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. Within this mission, the Identity Data Science portfolio plays a significant role in developing intelligence-driven solutions that improve how risk is understood and managed across the merchant lifecycle.

We are looking for a highly skilled and strategic Director to lead a Data Science team that focuses on solving merchant risk during onboarding and monitoring. This role is critical in driving the research and development of a merchant registry and profiling capability within the Identity Data Science portfolio. This includes setting the strategy for how merchant intelligence is built and scaled, guiding the development of reusable data science assets and profiling frameworks, and ensuring strong execution across product, engineering, and data science partners. You will help shape both the technical direction and operational model needed to turn this capability into a durable and scalable advantage.

Role

Key Responsibilities Include

Define and execute the strategy for solving merchant risk during onboarding and monitoring through the research and development of a merchant registry and profiling capability
Lead, coach, and develop high-performing teams of Data Scientists, including hiring, mentorship, and performance management
Build a strong team culture focused on collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning
Guide the design of scalable machine learning and analytical systems using modern data and cloud platforms such as Databricks and Sparks.
Establish best practices for problem framing, technique selection, experimentation, and validation across the team
Ensure teams identify appropriate approaches for business problems and rigorously validate solutions against both technical and business outcomes
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders to translate strategic needs into data science roadmaps and deliverables
Drive Agile delivery practices that support iterative development, measurable outcomes, and continuous improvement
Promote reusable data assets, standardization, and scalable workflows that strengthen long-term execution
Communicate strategy, progress, trade-offs, and business value clearly to senior leadership
Balance long-term vision with near-term delivery to maximize impact and time-to-value

All About You

Essential Skills to be successful:

Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD preferred) in Data Science, ML, or related field
Extensive experience leading a Data Science team and drive innovation with inspiration.
Experienced being a great people leader but able to dig into the work where necessary
A proven track record of deploying high performance machine learning models at scale in a production environment
Strong proficiency with Python, SQL, along with experience using scalable Machine Learning and Cloud frameworks
Strong ability to guide teams in identifying appropriate techniques and validating solutions rigorously
Critical thinking and a drive to produce high-quality work, ensuring that all solutions meet rigorous standards
Demonstrated success translating complex business problems into strategic data science initiatives. Ability to lead through ambiguity and change
Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, with the ability to drive iterative delivery across cross-functional teams
Excellent stakeholder management, communication to both technical and non-technical audiences, and leadership skills
Proven ability to build teams, influence roadmaps, and deliver measurable business value in complex environments
High-energy and self-driven orientation

Nice to Have

Experience building or scaling shared data science platforms, registries, or enterprise data assets
Familiarity with merchant risk, fraud, or identity ecosystems
Experience driving cross-team standardization and reusable capabilities
Exposure to governance frameworks for model validation and AI systems

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in Canada, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive pay based on location, experience and other qualifications for the role and may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. This is a pipeline posting for future opportunities within our team.

Pay Ranges

Vancouver, Canada: $154,000 - $247,000 CAD

Toronto, Canada: $154,000 - $247,000 CAD

Our client is a fast-growing Canadian manufacturer of custom conveyor systems, material handling solutions, and precision metal products that has doubled their business in the past 2 years. They credit this success in large part to talented professionals who make up their world-class manufacturing team. They are committed to sustaining this period of growth, investing in the people, equipment, process improvements, and technology the business needs to scale effectively.

As the company enters its next phase of growth, it is establishing a new Finance & Human Resources Leader position. This is a key leadership role responsible for financial reporting, planning, controls, and performance analysis, with a strong focus on manufacturing operations. The successful candidate will bring financial insight to business decisions, strengthen processes and reporting, and serve as a trusted partner to the General Manager and leadership team. The role also provides HR direction and oversight, supported by internal resources and external partners as needed- the individual does not need to be an HR specialist.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Finance & Financial Leadership

Lead the Finance function, overseeing financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, cash flow, working capital, and overall financial performance.
Prepare and communicate financial statements, management reporting, and analysis, providing actionable insights to the President & CEO and leadership team.
Oversee core financial operations, including AR, AP, payroll, banking, tax, audit, insurance and compliance, while maintaining strong financial controls and processes.
Provide financial oversight for capital expenditures and key business decisions, assessing risks, opportunities, and financial impact.

Manufacturing Finance

Develop a strong understanding of the company’s engineer-to-order manufacturing model and its key financial drivers.
Provide visibility into job costing, WIP, project margins and profitability, analyzing estimated versus actual performance across labour, materials and overhead.
Establish meaningful financial and operational KPIs and partner with Estimating, Sales, Engineering and Operations to translate operational performance into actionable financial insights.
Identify opportunities to improve margins, profitability, efficiency and working-capital management.

Human Resources

Provide leadership and oversight of the Human Resources function, ensuring policies and practices support business objectives, company culture and employment legislation.
Partner with managers on employee relations, performance management, recruitment, onboarding, retention, succession planning, compensation and benefits.

Leadership & Continuous Improvement

Serve as a trusted business partner to the President & CEO and an active member of the leadership team, contributing to strategic and organizational priorities.
Strengthen financial and HR systems, processes and reporting while identifying opportunities to automate repetitive work and leverage technology and AI to improve efficiency and decision-making.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Minimum 7 years of progressively senior experience in finance and accounting, ideally within a manufacturing environment; CPA designation is an asset.
Background in custom manufacturing, engineer-to-order, project-based, or similarly complex production settings.
Strong understanding of cost accounting, WIP, gross margin analysis, project profitability, and budget-to-actual performance.
Proven experience managing financial planning, forecasting, reporting, P&L oversight and cash flow management.
Strong knowledge of accounting practices, financial controls and governance, with experience improving financial processes and infrastructure.
Previous exposure to HR leadership or functional oversight, with an understanding of employee practices, policies and employment compliance.
Business-oriented and analytical, with the ability to connect financial and operational data to sound, practical business decisions.
Confident communicator and approachable leader who can build strong relationships across the organization, from senior leadership to front-line employees.
Proactive, hands-on, and continuous improvement-focused, with an openness to using technology, automation, and AI to enhance business efficiency.
